question: Is the compatible crawl-remote snapshot contract deployed and ready to become the required Gitcrawl cloud publication path?
rationale: The patch and repository tests cannot establish which remote revision is deployed or whether the cross-repository operator upgrade and rollback sequence is ready.

options.title: Require deployed proof
options.body: Approve only after the exact compatible remote revision and redacted live Worker/D1/R2 evidence are attached.

options.title: Stage the coordinated rollout
options.body: Keep the draft unreleased until all three repositories have pinned compatible versions and documented rollback behavior.

recommendation.title: Require deployed proof
recommendation.body: Approve only after the exact compatible remote revision and redacted live Worker/D1/R2 evidence are attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The current cloud publisher, coverage behavior, and coordinated snapshot dependency work trace to this owner.
